vector_memory.semantic_summary: FullscreenProgram is a rendering utility class designed to manage a specialized WebGL program for full-screen rendering passes. It encapsulates the setup for drawing a full-screen triangle, which is essential for post-processing effects like tone mapping or texture copying. The class handles the lifecycle of GPU resources, including compiling shaders and managing the Vertex Array Object (VAO) for efficient screen-space operations.
